extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: TabMail Voice listens only while you hold the dictation key.
extendInfo.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: TabMail Voice reads your calendars to answer what you ask, and adds the events you confirm.
extendInfo.NSRemindersFullAccessUsageDescription: TabMail Voice reads your reminders to answer what you ask, and adds the ones you confirm.
extendInfo.NSContactsUsageDescription: TabMail Voice looks up people in your contacts to answer what you ask, and adds the ones you confirm.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: TabMail Voice uses Notes and Messages to answer what you ask, and adds the notes and sends the messages you confirm.
